verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents personal API keys that let external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses with a Bearer header, and it has an API endpoints reference page. However, the API reference is marked experimental, and the interactive Swagger docs appear only on a self-hosted instance with ENV=dev. No hosted OpenAPI spec was found (all probed paths returned 404), and no REST deprecation window is promised. missing for 10: a stable non-experimental API reference, a publicly hosted OpenAPI spec or playground, a REST versioning/deprecation policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: An API key is a personal access token that lets external code call the same endpoints the web UI uses.
your scripts can do with a single `Authorization: Bearer` header.
Make sure to set the `ENV` environment variable to `dev` in order to access the Swagger documentation
